detail.longDescription: 🎉 Woodpecker Autoscaler 2.0.0 is out! Finally landed: a rewritten scheduler that respects agent labels and provider capabilities (OS, arch, ...). The groundwork for smarter scaling across mixed pools. ✨ New experimental providers: DigitalOcean & OpenStack 🔒 Cloud metadata endpoints get blackholed to protect the agent token 💸 Billing-aware agent teardown 🖼️ Custom images on Hetzner ⚠️ Breaking release, read the notes before upgrading: https:// github.com/woodpecker-ci/autos caler/releases/tag/2.0.0 # WoodpeckerCI # CICD # DevOps
